content.value_statement: Teams can miss common security defects before deployment. This skill provides a structured checklist for secrets, input validation, auth, and testing.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews of secrets management and environment variable usage.
Checks input validation, file upload controls, and SQL injection prevention.
Reviews authentication, authorization, cookie settings, and Supabase row level security.
Covers XSS, CSRF, rate limiting, logging, and sensitive error handling.
Includes blockchain wallet and transaction verification checkpoints.
Provides dependency, security testing, and pre-deployment checklist coverage.
limitations: It does not run automated scanners or prove that an application is secure.
Examples must be adapted to the project framework and threat model.
It cannot verify runtime configuration without access to the target environment.
It focuses on common application risks, not full compliance certification.

use_cases.title: Pre-release API review
use_cases.description: Review new API endpoints for validation, authorization, rate limits, and safe error handling before release.

use_cases.title: Authentication feature review
use_cases.description: Check token storage, cookie settings, role checks, and session handling while implementing login features.

use_cases.title: Security readiness checklist
use_cases.description: Use a concise checklist to confirm secrets, dependencies, logging, and deployment controls before production.

prompt_templates.title: Basic security pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change with the security checklist. Focus on secrets, input validation, authentication, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: API endpoint review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these API endpoints for authorization, validation, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and sensitive data exposure.

prompt_templates.title: Pre-deployment review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a pre-deployment security review. Identify blockers, missing controls, and specific fixes needed before production.

prompt_templates.title: Threat model review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this feature as a security reviewer. Map likely attack paths, prioritize risks, and recommend concrete mitigations.

output_examples.input: Review a new signup endpoint before release.
output_examples.output: Findings prioritized: validate email format, avoid detailed login errors, add rate limits, and store sessions in secure httpOnly cookies.

output_examples.input: Check a file upload workflow for common risks.
output_examples.output: Review result: enforce size limits, validate MIME type and extension, scan uploaded content, and prevent public execution of uploaded files.

output_examples.input: Assess a production readiness checklist for a payment feature.
output_examples.output: Release blockers: remove sensitive logs, verify authorization on payment actions, confirm dependency status, and document rollback handling.

best_practices: Run the checklist before merging security-sensitive changes.
Pair the review with automated tests and dependency scanning.
Record unresolved risks and owners before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Using the checklist as a replacement for tests or security tooling.
Ignoring framework-specific security requirements during implementation.
Approving sensitive changes without verifying authorization and logging behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill scan code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides a structured review and should be paired with scanners, tests, and manual verification.

faq.question: Which projects fit this skill best?
faq.answer: It fits web applications, API services, Supabase projects, Next.js apps, and security-sensitive product features.

faq.question: Can it review authentication changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers token storage, cookies, authorization checks, session handling, and role-based access controls.

faq.question: Does it cover dependency security?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts reviewers to check vulnerability reports, lock files, updates, and reproducible installs.

faq.question: Can it certify compliance?
faq.answer: No. It supports engineering review, but it does not provide legal, regulatory, or audit certification.

faq.question: How should teams use the output?
faq.answer: Treat findings as review input, assign owners, verify fixes, and document any accepted residual risk.
